source_method: Official public sources only; no authentication, paid data, CAPTCHA or user-supplied files
tracks: official subsidised-delivery statistics and quality methodology

sources.name: BDUK Delivery Performance, annual: April 2025 to March 2026
facts: 192,570 premises received gigabit-capable coverage through BDUK interventions in 2025/26
1,418,410 cumulative premises reported since gigabit programmes began
England accounted for approximately 145,110 premises delivered in 2025/26
sources.limitation: Aggregate subsidised delivery statistics do not identify current retail serviceability or orderability for an individual parcel.
sources.access_and_licence: Official Statistics on GOV.UK; Open Government Licence unless otherwise stated

sources.name: Quality and Methodology Information for BDUK Delivery Performance 2025/26
facts: Uses AddressBase Premium and Ofcom premises/postcode data among source inputs
Supplier submissions and historical time series can be revised
Some voucher premises are estimated through multiplier and attrition methods
sources.limitation: Methodology explains counting and quality controls; it is not live premises availability evidence.
sources.access_and_licence: Official GOV.UK methodology under Open Government Licence

sources.name: January 2026 OMR and premises in BDUK plans (England and Wales)
facts: Provides UPRN-level current gigabit, future plans and BDUK intervention fields
Applies to England and Wales
Includes regional ZIP files and a public sample CSV
sources.limitation: A BDUK UPRN record must still be joined to a trusted canonical parcel identity; classifications are not provider order confirmations.
sources.access_and_licence: Official GOV.UK premises publication under Open Government Licence

sources.name: UPRN level release user guide and technical note for premises in BDUK plans
facts: Premises base uses the latest AddressBase Premium epoch at the time of the OMR
Demolished and non-postal premises are filtered
Current gigabit, future gigabit and intervention fields have distinct meanings
sources.limitation: The release is BDUK's current view for technical users and does not provide historical delivery completeness or live installation status.
sources.access_and_licence: Official GOV.UK technical note under Open Government Licence

sources.name: Broadband and mobile coverage checker
sources.published_or_updated: Current checker page verified 31 July 2026; page last updated 25 June 2025
facts: Broadband checker accepts postcode and address
Reports standard, superfast and ultrafast availability
Fixed and mobile data are available to developers through an API
sources.limitation: Checker output is predicted/availability data and cannot establish title-parcel equivalence, installation completion or current provider order acceptance.
sources.access_and_licence: Official Ofcom service; checker and API terms apply

sources.name: Map Your Mobile
facts: Shows predicted 4G/5G coverage by network for a postcode
Separates indoor/outdoor coverage and performance indicators
Performance uses district-level evidence including crowdsourced Opensignal data
sources.limitation: Postcode and district mobile results are not fixed broadband availability and are not exact parcel-level serviceability.
sources.access_and_licence: Official Ofcom consumer checker; Ofcom terms apply

sources.name: Connected Nations update: Spring 2026
facts: Fixed broadband ZIP is listed as a 32.2 MB downloadable archive
Coverage checkers were updated from the collected data
All-premises downloadable data remains distinct from residential headline figures
sources.limitation: The official archive still requires real byte, filename, header and row-count validation before migration.
sources.access_and_licence: Official Ofcom report and data; Ofcom terms of use apply

sources.name: July 2026: Premises contracted and built under Project Gigabit contracts
facts: Monthly contract-level contracted and built premises table
Figures are rounded to the nearest 10
Publication warns of data-ingestion lag and non-comparability with official statistics
sources.limitation: Contract-level built totals and management information do not prove that a particular parcel is serviceable or orderable.
sources.access_and_licence: Official GOV.UK publication under Open Government Licence
